evidence_digest_convention: sha256 over the artefact's content with line endings normalised to LF: a checkout rewrites line endings without touching content, so the same commit must fingerprint the same on a runner as on the machine that produced the record

supersession.reason: RFC-TAP-CI-003: the audit was regenerated (stale entrypoint digest) and its check is now read-only, so the explorer, its verification and the producer pins were re-issued in the same commit
supersession.how: the record file is replaced, but the previous fingerprint, candidate head and a digest of its evidence table are kept here, so a reader can see that the certification was re-issued and what it replaced

superseded_chain.reason: WP-8 closed a reproducibility defect in this lane's pins: a byte pin over the audit could only be satisfied on the machine that wrote it, so the explorer now publishes a state pin and the gate judges a state-pinned input on its state. The producer digests were re-captured in the same commit
superseded_chain.how: the record file is replaced, but the previous fingerprint, candidate head and a digest of its evidence table are kept here, so a reader can see that the certification was re-issued and what it replaced

scope: certification that the published cost-barrier artefacts reproduce from their declared inputs on this candidate, and that the gate detects the tampering in the adversarial contract. It is not a claim of profitability, and it authorizes nothing: no promotion, no paper or live execution, no capital, no order path
